checks.name: Live session is first content section; remaining order retained on desktop and mobile
Mobile controls, slider and bars precede the info menu and assumptions; extra year label hidden only by mobile CSS
2008 start, current-year startup, horizon switching, thumb year and both calculation choices work
All ten languages translate the new information menu and retain all six synchronized selectors
Mobile and desktop resizing restores the original explanatory positions and keeps counters working
Mobile no longer rebuilds metric containers, while the desktop rendering path is retained
Hidden methodology does not update; open methodology retains its nodes and receives current values
Numbers, fuel/CO2 texts, fire counts and elapsed time match V3.2.2 for all five regions
Desktop scenario arrangement and live displayed values match V3.2.2, apart from requested session order and version label
Session counters use continuous one-decimal model changes, locale separators and stable fractional spans in both views
Numerical input parameters, scenario engine and history datasets are unchanged
All IDs unique and method links still target the matching section

limits: No physical iPhone reproduction or graphical layout verification. DOM checks do not prove that all Safari scrolling symptoms are eliminated.
